items.briefing:
Cybersecurity expert Troy Hunt has published his latest weekly update focused on cyber ransoms, a reminder that ransomware remains an active threat to Australian organisations of all sizes. Separately, research highlights that AI tools like Glean may be quietly increasing workloads for Australian employees, and raises questions about how staff interact with AI platforms and the data they share through them.

Security researchers have also demonstrated that AI agents can generate self-replicating malware with minimal human involvement — a concerning development for any organisation using AI tools internally. **Practical tip:** Review what data your staff are sharing with AI workplace tools and ensure your organisation has a clear policy on approved platforms.

featured.title: Glean: AI creating hidden workload for Australian employees
featured.quote: Australian workers waste 6.5 hours weekly on AI oversight, revealing hidden productivity costs.
